variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high fidelity iPhone finance app Home screen concept for the existing local-first app Trexpend. Portrait image with a single straight-on iPhone screen, thin dark frame, no perspective, full screen visible, tiny neutral margins. All text in ENGLISH. This is Concept A, favorites-first. Calm native SwiftUI light appearance, restrained Blue Slate accent #4F636E, graphite #263238 text, very pale gray #F4F5F6 background, white rounded grouped rows, SF-style typography. No bright gradients, charts, avatars, ads, banking marketing, or decorative illustrations. Standard top status bar and subtle bottom home indicator. Large title "Home". Below: a dark desaturated slate card with label "Total balance", large amount "11,090.00", small explicit code "CAD". Below card, month label "October 2026" and two equal compact white summary cards: "Income" "4,200.00 CAD" with small muted green incoming arrow; "Expenses" "1,850.50 CAD" with small muted red outgoing arrow. Account section heading "Accounts" and small native grouping menu button "Favorites" with downward chevron. Group header "FAVORITES": exactly two rows: rounded type icon, "Everyday card", subtitle "North Bank · Checking", amount "2,450.00 CAD", small favorite star, right chevron; second "Cash wallet", subtitle "Cash", amount "180.00 CAD", small star, chevron. Group header "OTHER ACCOUNTS": exactly three rows: "Travel card", subtitle "Atlas Bank · Checking", amount "120,000.00 UAH"; "Credit card", subtitle "North Bank · Credit card", amount "-380.00 CAD"; "Savings deposit", subtitle "North Bank · Deposit", amount "5,000.00 CAD". Each row has a different simple system type icon and right chevron. Account amounts right aligned and monospaced digit style, native currency code always visible. Favorites never repeated below. Five account rows total. Visually comfortable spacing, all five rows and tab bar visible; budget screen height carefully. A small slate circular plus button floats lower-right ABOVE the tab bar and must not cover the last row. Bottom native rounded tab bar has exactly three icon/label tabs: Home selected in slate, All, Settings unselected gray. Outside phone, small caption "A · Favorites first". These are synthetic example accounts and balances, not actual user data. Render polished, realistic, legible native iOS UI with precise spelling and no extra features.
